issues.description: The QFT forward method name in the template differs from the solution and from the task referenced in the problem statement. The template defines a method named _qft_circuit(...), while the solution and the exercise/test expectation use qft_circuit(...). This naming mismatch will confuse students and likely cause automated tests to fail because the expected public method is missing in the template.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template method _qft_circuit to qft_circuit (remove the leading underscore) so the forward QFT implementation method matches the problem statement/test expectation and the solution reference. Alternatively update documentation/tests to expect _qft_circuit, but the simpler fix is to use qft_circuit in the template.
